toolsPreview.name: generate_docstring

toolsPreview.name: analyze_complexity
toolsPreview.description: Analyze code complexity including cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, nesting depth, and maintainability index.

toolsPreview.name: suggest_refactor
